senses.gloss: only in מ׳ דנורא embers. [Comm. identify our w. with preced., referring to the double meaning of לָהַשׁ.] Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ (Var. מוֹלְלָא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400).—Pl. מִלְלֵי, מִי׳.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 109b:10">Sabb. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>בי מיללי דנ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>במל׳</he>) between the embers.

senses.gloss: gold ore as broken in the mine.
units: Keth. 67ᵃ במ׳ Ar. (ed. במַמְלָא) it means ore (Rashi: gold leaf).
